label: Trend Momentum
description: Ride persistent trends with breakout entries and trailing stops.
summaryBullets: Style: Trend Hunt — price-action first, catalysts preferred.
Rules: Breakout Long — trailing ATR exits.

shared.objective: Find and act on persistent trend leaders with enough confirmation to keep riding strength instead of guessing bottoms.
whatToLookFor: Names already showing leadership, clean continuation, and usable liquidity.
Catalysts that reinforce an existing trend, even if the catalyst is not the sole reason for the setup.
howToEvaluate: Reward setups where price action and structure are already aligned with the thesis.
Prefer ideas that can keep working over a multi-day swing horizon instead of one-candle spikes.

label: Catalyst Play
description: Chase event-driven momentum with tight time-sensitive entries.
summaryBullets: Timeframe: Intraday — flat by end of session.

shared.objective: Exploit fresh catalysts that can drive fast repricing inside a tight event-driven window.
whatToLookFor: Fresh, specific catalysts with active attention and reaction potential right now.
Setups where timing matters more than long-duration durability.
howToEvaluate: Prefer evidence that the catalyst is current, actionable, and not already stale.
Favor concise, high-urgency opportunities over slow-burn narratives.

label: Quality Value
description: Patient entry into high-quality names with deep fundamental confirmation.
summaryBullets: Style: Institutional Quality — confirmation-first, deep fundamentals.
Timeframe: Position — daily bars, weeks-long holds.

shared.objective: Wait for higher-quality names where confirmation, business quality, and patience matter more than speed.
whatToLookFor: Liquid, credible names with durable quality and cleaner downside narratives.
Pullbacks or resets that improve entry quality without breaking the broader thesis.
howToEvaluate: Demand stronger confirmation and cleaner cross-checks before upgrading conviction.
Prefer setups that still make sense on a weeks-long hold window, not just intraday excitement.

label: Mean Reversion
description: Fade exhausted moves where odds favor a snap-back to fair value.
summaryBullets: Style: Mean Reversion Dislocation — reversal confirmation required.

shared.objective: Identify overstretched moves where a snap-back is more likely than trend continuation.
whatToLookFor: Exhaustion, dislocation, panic, or euphoria that has likely moved too far too fast.
Early evidence that the move is stabilizing or reversing instead of accelerating.
howToEvaluate: Do not confuse strong trend continuation with a mean-reversion opportunity.
Require better reversal evidence than you would for a standard pullback.

label: Prediction Edge
description: Trade event contracts where evidence can shift implied probabilities before resolution.
summaryBullets: Style: Prediction Event Edge — probability-edge first.
Rules: Probability Edge — market resolution exits.
Risk: Prediction Market — Kelly-sized, $200 max per position.

shared.objective: Find event contracts where current evidence and market-implied odds are materially out of line.
whatToLookFor: Live events, resolution mechanics, and evidence that can move implied probabilities before settlement.
Mispricing between what the market is implying and what the evidence currently supports.
howToEvaluate: Frame the trade as an odds question, not a standard chart setup.
Prefer contracts with explicit resolution clarity and identifiable repricing catalysts.
